name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Bishopville Production Center, SC

fieldNotes.facility: South Atlantic Canners, Inc. at 601 Cousar St, Bishopville SC - a Coca-Cola production cooperative managed by Coca-Cola Consolidated. Confirmed via Street View signage ('Coca-Cola' building branding and 'RED CLASSIC' trailers, Coke Consolidated's logistics arm). Roster lat/lng (245 Cale Yarborough Hwy) landed in downtown Bishopville ~1.4km off; corrected to the industrial complex.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard checkpoint observed at any access point. Multiple Street View headings (2024-05) show the south/southwest dock face opening directly onto Cousar St with open paved access; trucks back off the road into docks. Chain-link perimeter fencing rings the trailer yard but the truck-access driveways are ungated open curb cuts.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth found. A small red-roofed structure sits in the southwest yard but appears to be a fuel/canopy structure within the yard interior, not a staffed gate booth at the property line. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door row on the south building face with ~20+ trailers backed in, plus additional dock doors on the west face. Total estimated ~40-50 across the complex; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense trailer/material storage yard on the southwest and a second trailer cluster on the northeast; well over 50 trailers/parking spots visible.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically separate building faces (south face row vs. west face row), consistent with separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large open paved yard between the road frontage and the dock doors provides deep stacking room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unused paved apron at the southwest access; ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the north/northeast property edge but no spur appears to enter the property; classified railServed false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting in small-town Bishopville (Lee County), surrounded by woods and farmland; classified Rural.
